pressure_note: Column headed 'Pressure, Atm.'; CO2 admitted to the autoclave and pressure held manually (Bourdon gauges); text does not say whether gauge or absolute, total pressure or CO2 partial pressure (vessel evacuated to 10 microns before filling, so atmosphere is CO2 plus water vapour)
gas_basis_evidence: solubility reported as g CO2 per 100 g solvent, not as gas mole fraction
footnotes_as_printed: The paper has no footnotes on this table.
conversion_needs: g CO2 per 100 g solvent to molality or mole fraction needs CO2 and H2O molar masses (and for sea water, which 'solvent' is meant)
title_as_printed: Solubility of Carbon Dioxide in Synthetic Sea Water

value.what: g CO2 per 100 g solvent; for sea water the paper says the CO2 from the 0.202 g/kg NaHCO3 is included in the reported values

composition.other_species: NaHCO3 0.202 g/kg and NaBr 0.083 g/kg (Table I, Subow/Brujewicz recipe; total salts 34.420 g/kg, 35.220 g/L; H2O 965.579 g/kg). Units g per kg of synthetic sea water as printed in Table I

notes: Matrix pressure x temperature (-5, 0, 5, 10, 12.4, 15, 25 C) written stacked by temperature; dots written as empty cells. 9 pressures x 7 temperatures = 63 cells, 42 measured. Normal-strength synthetic sea water.
